_note: One entry per bundled atlas. All volumes are int16 on the FSL MNI152 2 mm grid (91 x 109 x 91), voxel value = label, 0 = background. Pair a volume only with the labels.csv in its own folder.

caveats.combined: Built by the lab, not an official release: Schaefer regions keep labels 1 to 100, Tian regions are numbered 100 + their own label (right hemisphere first). The two atlases overlap in 74 voxels, which were given to the Tian region. Cite Schaefer et al. (2018) and Tian et al. (2020, Nature Neuroscience, doi 10.1038/s41593-020-00711-6).
caveats.aal3: AAL was drawn on a single-subject MNI brain (Colin27), not the MNI152 average; it is commonly used with MNI152 data without warping. Label values have gaps (35 and 36 are unused).
